        int st, ed, flow, next;

        int t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        mat = new int[20001][20001];

                } else if (s.charAt(j) == 'Z') {

                    zc = j + 1;
                    ma[i][j + 1] = -1;
                } else if (s.charAt(j) > '0' && s.charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    hu[++cx][0] = i;
                    hu[cx][1] = j + 1;
                    hu[cx][2] = s.charAt(j) - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String s = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {

                    re[++cy][0] = i;
                    re[cy][1] = j + 1;
                    re[cy][2] = s.charAt(j) - '0';

        head = new int[20001];

                int p1 = (hu[i][0] - 1) * n + hu[i][1];

    static int isok(int r, int c) {
        if (r > 0 && r <= n && c > 0 && c <= n && ma[r][c] != -1) {
            return (r - 1) * n + c;
        }

    static void Floyd() {
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {

    static void BG() {

    static int dinic() {

                }

        }
        return ret;

    static boolean dinic_bfs() {

                    if (ed == dest) return d[dest] >= 0;
                    que[rear++] = ed;
                }

        return 0;
    }

    static void BF() {
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        E = 0;
        src = 0;
        dest = cx + cy + 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= cx; i++) {

                if (mat[p1][p2] != -1 && mat[p1][p2] <= t && mat[p1][p2] < dis[p2]) {
                    addEdge(i, cx + j, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                } else if (mat[p1][p2] != -1 && mat[p1][p2] <= t && mat[p1][p2] == dis[p2]) {
